label: Figure 16.10: Increase in AD while operating below full employment (phase 1)
alt: A Keynesian AS curve with AD shifting right from AD1 to AD2, both crossing the flat section. Real output rises from Y1 to Y2 and the price level stays at P.
caption: With spare capacity, AD shifts right from AD<sub>1</sub> to AD<sub>2</sub> (purple arrows) along the flat section of AS. Real output rises from Y<sub>1</sub> to Y<sub>2</sub> but the price level stays at P: unused resources are employed at no extra cost, so there is no inflationary pressure.
